# How to Lock In Lower AI Costs with Reserved Capacity

**Hook:**
Want to cut your AI spending without cutting corners? OpenAI’s Reserved Capacity lets you lock in a fixed, lower rate for predictable workloads — saving up to 50% compared to pay-as-you-go. Best of all, you can set it up in under 10 minutes.

## Before you start
- An **OpenAI account** (free to create at [platform.openai.com](https://platform.openai.com))
- A **credit card** or **prepaid billing method** (required for all paid plans)
- A **project or workload** that uses ChatGPT, fine-tuning, or batch API calls regularly
- Rough time: **10 minutes** to complete
- Note: Reserved Capacity is a **paid add-on** and requires a billing plan (not available on free tier)

---

## Step 1 — Open the OpenAI Platform dashboard
Log in to your OpenAI account and go to the **Platform dashboard**. You’ll see a left-hand menu with options like “Models,” “API keys,” and “Billing.” Look for a section called **“Reserved Capacity”** — it’s usually near the bottom, under “Billing.”

💬 Example:
```text
https://platform.openai.com/
```
You’ll know it worked when you see a clean dashboard with your name in the top-right corner and the “Reserved Capacity” link visible.

---

## Step 2 — Start a new Reserved Capacity purchase
In the Reserved Capacity section, click the **“Purchase”** or **“Get Started”** button. A new page will open showing pricing tiers and usage estimates. Don’t worry if the numbers look big — you’re not committing to anything yet.

💬 Example:
```text
Click: "Purchase Reserved Capacity"
```
You’ll know it worked when you see a form with options like “Model,” “Duration,” and “Usage Tier.”

---

## Step 3 — Choose your model and duration
Select the AI model you use most (e.g., **gpt-4o** or **gpt-4o-mini**). Then pick a duration: 1 month, 3 months, or 6 months. The longer the term, the bigger the discount — up to 50% off standard rates. Think of it like buying a bulk pack of coffee: the more you commit, the cheaper each cup becomes.

💬 Example:
```text
Model: gpt-4o-mini
Duration: 3 months
```
You’ll know it worked when the estimated savings appear on screen and the “Continue” button lights up.

---

## Step 4 — Set your usage tier and confirm
Enter how many tokens or requests you expect to use per month. If you’re not sure, use the **“Estimate”** tool — it’ll suggest a tier based on your recent usage. Double-check the total cost, then click **“Confirm Purchase.”** You’ll see a confirmation screen with a summary and a receipt.

💬 Example:
```text
Usage Tier: 10M tokens/month
Total: $120 (after 40% discount)
```
You’ll know it worked when you receive an email titled “Your Reserved Capacity is active” and the status changes to **“Active”** in the dashboard.

---

## Step 5 — Assign capacity to your projects
Now, link your Reserved Capacity to specific projects or API keys. Go to the **“Projects”** tab and select the project you want to optimise. Under “Billing,” choose **“Apply Reserved Capacity.”** Your usage will now draw from the reserved pool first, saving you money.

💬 Example:
```text
Project: Customer Support Bot
Apply: Reserved Capacity (gpt-4o-mini, 3 months)
```
You’ll know it worked when the project shows “Reserved Capacity active” and your usage graph drops in cost.

---

## Step 6 — Monitor usage and adjust
Keep an eye on your **Usage dashboard**. If you’re close to your reserved limit, you’ll see a warning. You can always buy more capacity or switch to pay-as-you-go for extra usage — no downtime.

💬 Example:
```text
Check: Usage > Reserved Capacity > Alerts
```
You’ll know it worked when you see real-time cost tracking and alerts before you hit your limit.

---

## Common mistakes
- **Mistake:** Buying capacity for a model you rarely use.
  **Fix:** Stick to the model you actually use daily — otherwise, you’re paying for unused capacity.

- **Mistake:** Not estimating usage correctly.
  **Fix:** Use the built-in estimator or check your last 3 months of API logs to pick a realistic tier.

- **Mistake:** Forgetting to assign capacity to a project.
  **Fix:** Always link your reserved capacity to the project you want to save on — otherwise, it won’t apply.

---

## What this means for you

- **In everyday life:** If you use ChatGPT Plus or API for personal projects (like automating emails or summarising articles), Reserved Capacity can cut your monthly bill in half. Just commit to a 3-month plan and watch the savings add up.

- **For your business or work:** If your team uses AI for customer support, content generation, or data analysis, locking in a 6-month Reserved Capacity can save thousands per year. It’s predictable budgeting for unpredictable workloads.

- **If you're just getting started:** Start small — try a 1-month plan for gpt-4o-mini. Once you see the savings, you can scale up confidently.

---

## Try it now
Open the [OpenAI Platform](https://platform.openai.com), go to Reserved Capacity, and start a 1-month plan for gpt-4o-mini. You’ll see the discount appear instantly — and your wallet will thank you later.
